decision_rule.admitted: ADMITTED if and only if all four hold against the SEALED ANCHOR's score artifact: (1) the CI95 LOWER bound of the paired official pooled SLU-F1 delta is greater than 0; (2) intent is non-inferior at the own-null margin -- its CI95 lower bound exceeds -1.0051; (3) the TRAIN symmetric scorer slurp-slu-f1-normalized-v1-train agrees in sign with the unprojected primary; and (4) no scenario loses intent beyond the null band -- no scenario's paired intent CI95 upper bound lies below zero.
decision_rule.harmful_first: HARMFUL is read FIRST (owner decision 25, Method B): only by a MEASURED loss -- a point estimate of the official pooled SLU-F1 delta or of the intent delta below -h (-1.1218 / -1.0051), or a CI95 UPPER bound below zero. An interval that straddles zero with the point estimate inside the margin is NOT harmful; it reads NEUTRAL with 'non-inferiority not proven' stated in those words.
decision_rule.neutral: NEUTRAL otherwise. Under owner decision 30 a NEUTRAL or HARMFUL one-factor read advances the headroom-exhausted streak; a beneficial but not CI95-proven movement is RECORDED as such (owner decision 25) and never claimed as an admission.
decision_rule.null_margin_source: cell B0r's own null on this exact TRAIN A roster and geometry (docs/results/2026-09-17-slurp-b0-review-off-redecision-v2.md). Owner decision 38: a contrast involving a configuration uses that configuration's own request-identical replicate; the sealed anchor has none, so B0r's own null is the registered fallback. The retired imported DEV-1000 half-widths are never used.
decision_rule.stop_condition: STOP and write the verdict as soon as the primary and its guard are computed once. No re-scoring, no second estimator, no re-weighting after seeing a number, no row filtering.
decision_rule.twin_rule: No twin is registered here. A derangement or token-matched control flies only if this cell shows a positive CI95 lower bound against the anchor, by the program's twin rule (owner ruling 2026-09-06: lock a score against a token-matched control, not against a token count).

A structural smoke result is never a quality result, and this is not a bar attempt. The verdict states the official pooled SLU the arm reaches and whether it clears 64.00 as a FACT, never as a claim.

purpose: Cell B8b-anchor. Owner directive 26 of 2026-09-18 asks that an analysis this program trusts be placed INSIDE an agent node; item E12 built the read-side instance, the A3 coverage / slot-loss audits rendered as declared context at the Reviewer boundary. That cell was registered on the Node Context Policy L1 stack. Cell B7a v2 read that stack HARMFUL on 2026-09-19 and owner decision 32 fired: cells B7r and B7c close unflown and cell B8b is RE-BASED on the sealed dual-store anchor and re-registered. The block never depended on the L1 policy -- the B7a v2 rendering diagnostics show the structured review-finding boundaries falling back to raw on 100 % of rows, so the audit read no parsed Reviewer output, only the structured RENDERING SLOT of the Reviewer's draft boundary. Item E19 gives it a second attachment: with the boundary at raw, the block is appended to the SEALED draft bytes the Reviewer already receives. This cell measures, on the official number, whether a deterministic, zero-contact audit of the draft the Reviewer is about to criticise moves the loop's outcome.
quality_gate: The four-row smoke is structural only and is never scored. The arm's official number is read exactly once, under the decision rule fixed above before any number is seen.

flags.EMPTY-DRAFT: an entity-free draft for an intent whose construction rows carry an entity at least as often as empty_draft_min_entity_row_share
flags.MISSING-COMMON: an entity type attested with the drafted intent on at least missing_common_min_row_share of its construction rows and absent from the draft
flags.REPRESENTATION: a filler that violates saea-spoken-form-v1 (no ASCII digit, no colon, no slash) for a type whose released convention is spoken
flags.TYPE-UNSEEN: an entity TYPE in the draft that the construction table never attests with the drafted intent
